headline: Nath Bio-Genes (India) Limited files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Nath Bio-Genes has filed a mandatory disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI Takeover Regulations, signalling a substantial acquisition event triggering public disclosure obligations on the NSE.
detail: Nath Bio-Genes (India) Limited has submitted a mandatory disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, as required when a party acquires shares or voting rights exceeding specified thresholds. The disclosure was filed with the NSE. The filing triggers transparency requirements and may necessitate an open offer if the acquirer crosses the 26% threshold or if specified conditions are met under the Takeover Code.
